signals.title: @MizarVision: Satellite imagery from Soar Atlas appears to show fresh damage to an aircraft hangar at Muwaffaq Salti Air Base in Jordan following Iran’s l
signals.content: Satellite imagery from Soar Atlas appears to show fresh damage to an aircraft hangar at Muwaffaq Salti Air Base in Jordan following Iran’s latest ballistic missile strike. OSINT analysis places the impact near a hangar associated with F-16 operations, although the exact function of the structure and any aircraft losses have not yet been independently confirmed. Muwaffaq Salti hosts U.S. forces and the 332nd Air Expeditionary Wing. Approx. coordinates: 31.829°N, 36.800°E Imagery: Soar Atlas Important: the strike itself is confirmed, but claims that a specific U.S. aircraft was destroyed remain unverified.
